items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But when did uh Hashiobake and Frank Christian and uh Johnny Stein get in New York?

ctx.x: Is that five after one? Yeah it's five after one. Okay I gotta pack and get up here to eat. It's tomorrow. We leave at six something in the morning.
But when did uh Hashiobake and Frank Christian and uh Johnny Stein get in New York? They had Frank low time?
I brought my brother up there. I brought Frank up there. Yeah.
